name: Chirag Chhatbar
player_statement:
A complete player, Chirag Chhatbar has made a big mark in cricket. With 26 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 29, with an average of 11.41 and a quick strike rate of 116.74. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 13 sixes and 19 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 37.3 overs, taking 20 wickets at an economy rate of 10.24. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
